message.content: {"summary":"A competent, well-structured mission design that covers most requirements with STK evidence and a clear mission rationale. To reach the next level, tighten the orbital analysis (RAAN consistency, hand calculations), justify the launch vehicle with data, complete the EOL discussion, and professionalise referencing and figures.","criteria":{"C1":"Your Introduction clearly states the mission purpose, the single-spacecraft rationale and the users, with literature support. To reach the top of Accomplished, firm up the user discussion (avoid 'likely') and cite specific operator/customer commitments rather than speculative wording.","C2":"You cover all major design elements with STK screenshots and an access table, but several errors weaken persuasiveness. The RAAN of 27.33° is inconsistent with a Kourou launch into a 97.79° SSO; the Vega E choice is speculative with no mass/cost analysis; no hand calculation supports the 97.7924° inclination; and the EOL paragraph is truncated. Fix these and add quantitative evidence to move from Adequate to Accomplished.","C3":"Your Conclusion recaps the design and flags launch risk, but remains a generic summary. To reach Accomplished, state quantitative outcomes (orbit, contact frequency, lifetime) and critically assess trade-offs and residual risks against the evidence in the main body.","C4":"Headings and structure are logical, but referencing is not professional: bare URLs, Wikipedia as a source, and inconsistent citation formatting. Figures are partly unlabelled and some writing errors remain. To reach Accomplished, use a consistent citation style, replace Wikipedia with primary sources, label all figures/tables, and proofread."},"next_steps":["Recompute and justify the RAAN for your Kourou launch time, and add a hand calculation for the 97.7924° SSO inclination to support the STK plot.","Replace the Vega E with a flown vehicle or provide payload mass, cost and schedule evidence; complete the EOL section with a quantitative deorbit time and drag-sail sizing.","Rebuild the bibliography in a consistent style using primary sources (no Wikipedia or bare URLs), label every figure and table, and proofread for wording errors such as the 'low resolution images' claim."]}
